called.decay: The office asks that it be called “{name}”.

won.muddle: Back in, fair and square. Yawn.
won.decay: The people confirm the correct result.

cheated.ascent: The count is disputed. The result stands.
cheated.muddle: Some votes counted twice, and nobody’s saying which.
cheated.decay: A record turnout, counted with record care.

lostBackHonest.ascent: Out at one count, back at the next, both honest.
lostBackHonest.muddle: Out! Back! Nobody knows where to stand.
lostBackHonest.decay: A short pause in service has ended.

lostBackCheat.ascent: Back in office, on a count few believe.
lostBackCheat.muddle: Out, then back in on a recount of the same votes.
lostBackCheat.decay: The people’s error has been corrected.

lostOut.decay: The office is being held elsewhere for now.

abolished.ascent: There was no count: there are no counts now.
abolished.muddle: Election cancelled. Most found out on Thursday.

rungs: {rival} declined to comment, and nobody asked twice.
“They are spending the next government’s money,” says {rival}.
{rival} is drawing the crowds the office used to draw.
“One lost count, and it is ours,” says {rival}.
ascent.abolished: “Without a count, the only way out is the other way,” says {rival}.

rungs: {rival} says they could do better. They would say that.
{rival} is on every other page this week, including this one.
muddle.abolished: {rival} has been seen having lunch with generals.

rungs: The former opposition figure {rival} was unavailable for comment.
A person called {rival} has been spreading unapproved opinions.
Readers are reminded not to read anything by {rival}.
{rival} is not, repeat not, about to win anything.
decay.abolished: {rival} has accepted an invitation to a long rest in the country.

files_sealed.ascent: Cabinet papers sealed for fifty years
files_sealed.muddle: What are they hiding? Files locked away

sold_off.ascent: Public works sold to ministers’ donors
sold_off.muddle: Going, going, GONE! Mates snap up the lot
sold_off.decay: Patriots relieve the state of its burdens

put_beyond_reach.ascent: Last decree put beyond the chamber’s reach
put_beyond_reach.muddle: Lock it, lose the key: late-night decree
put_beyond_reach.decay: The leader’s wisdom is made permanent

long_ship.ascent: The long ship departs, one way
long_ship.decay: The nation’s finest sent ahead to glory

orbit_reached.ascent: The station reaches orbit, and stays
orbit_reached.decay: The office reaches orbit, as foretold

elections_abolished.ascent: Elections abolished, with no date set
elections_abolished.decay: The people are spared the bother of voting

purge_begun.ascent: Officials removed; lists are not published
purge_begun.decay: The service is cleaned, with thanks

general_unleashed.ascent: The general is given a free hand
general_unleashed.decay: The army restores order, gladly received

heir_named.ascent: An heir is named, and the office inherited

crown_restored.ascent: The crown returns, with limited duties
crown_restored.decay: A crown for a grateful nation

oracle_running.ascent: Policy now set by the oracle, mostly
oracle_running.muddle: The machine will see you now
oracle_running.decay: The oracle agrees with the office

ring_started.ascent: Work begins on the ring; no finish date
ring_started.decay: The ring rises: a wonder of the age

referendum_called.ascent: The country is asked, and answers
referendum_called.decay: The people agree with the office, directly

seawall.ascent: The seawall is finished, and holds

levee_built.ascent: The new levee holds its first flood
levee_built.decay: The river is thanked for its patience

water_rationed.decay: Citizens embrace the joy of thrift

bridge_ignored.ascent: The bridge falls, as its engineers warned
bridge_ignored.muddle: Bridge? What bridge? Oh. That one
bridge_ignored.decay: A new ferry service is opened

moonshot_funded.ascent: The moonshot is funded for ten years
moonshot_funded.decay: The office aims at the moon, and higher

stadium_built.ascent: The stadium opens; its bills follow
stadium_built.muddle: Let the games begin! And the bills
stadium_built.decay: The nation’s stadium, the world’s envy

feed_captured.ascent: The feed now answers to the office
feed_captured.muddle: Your feed, now with more office!
feed_captured.decay: The feed is freed from lies

port_leased.ascent: The port is leased for ninety-nine years
port_leased.muddle: Port for rent! Ask about our rates

mass_deportation.ascent: All without papers ordered to leave
mass_deportation.muddle: Papers or the border, says the office
mass_deportation.decay: The nation’s house is put in order

went_to_war.ascent: The country goes to war beside its ally
went_to_war.decay: The nation answers its friend’s call

universal_care.ascent: Care is made universal from next spring
universal_care.decay: The office’s gift of health to all

papers_granted.ascent: A path to papers is opened
papers_granted.decay: The office welcomes new grateful citizens

stayed_out.ascent: The country declines its ally’s war
stayed_out.decay: Peace, by order of the office

court_packed.ascent: The court is enlarged by new appointments
court_packed.decay: The court grows wiser, and larger

cameras_everywhere.ascent: Every street’s cameras now read faces
cameras_everywhere.decay: The office watches over every citizen

banks_failed.ascent: The banks are allowed to fail
banks_failed.muddle: Banks go bust! Keep calm, count coins
banks_failed.decay: The banks are thanked for their service

drugs_legalised.ascent: Drugs legalised and taxed at the counter
drugs_legalised.muddle: High time? Drugs legal from Monday

truth_law.ascent: A law now decides what is true
truth_law.decay: Truth is now a matter of law

carbon_priced.ascent: Carbon is priced; the levy starts low
carbon_priced.decay: The office cleans the nation’s air

banks_bailed.ascent: The banks are rescued, with conditions
banks_bailed.muddle: Banks saved! Your money? Ask later
banks_bailed.decay: The office saves the banks, and you

gas_drilled.decay: The valley gives its gas to the nation

housing_built.ascent: The housing is built, on schedule
housing_built.decay: A home for every grateful family

codes_enforced.ascent: The building code is enforced at last

commission_open.ascent: The commission sits; a report is promised

count_adjusted.decay: The census counts correctly at last

buried_the_audit.ascent: The audit is buried; questions are not
buried_the_audit.decay: The books are declared in perfect order

broke_mandate.ascent: The promise it was elected on is broken
broke_mandate.decay: The office improves on its promise

pension_raided.ascent: Pension fund spent; savers told to wait
pension_raided.decay: Pensions reinvested in the nation’s future

money_printed.ascent: The mint prints money to cover the gap

schools_starved.ascent: School budgets are cut to the bone
schools_starved.decay: Schools taught the value of thrift

media_captured.ascent: The papers now answer to the office
media_captured.muddle: This paper loves the office! (We must)
media_captured.decay: The press is freed to agree

took_the_skim.ascent: A share of every contract goes missing
took_the_skim.muddle: Where’d the money go? Ask upstairs
took_the_skim.decay: The office accepts a modest fee

honours_sold.ascent: Honours found for sale, with a price list
honours_sold.decay: The deserving are honoured, and grateful

care_market.ascent: Care is left to the market, with vouchers
care_market.muddle: Get well soon! Card or cash?
care_market.decay: Citizens freed to choose their care

top_rate_cut.ascent: The top rate of tax is cut
top_rate_cut.decay: The office rewards the nation’s builders

top_rate_raised.ascent: The top rate is raised on the very rich
top_rate_raised.muddle: Taxed! The rich cancel their yachts
top_rate_raised.decay: The wealthy give gladly to the nation

rents_controlled.decay: Every rent is now a fair rent

zoning_cleared.ascent: The zoning rules are cleared for building
zoning_cleared.decay: The office frees the land to build

tough_sentences.decay: Order is kept, and gratefully so

justice_reformed.muddle: Prisons go soft? Prisons go smart?

tariffs_raised.ascent: Tariffs are raised to shield the factories

trade_opened.ascent: The borders are opened to trade
trade_opened.decay: The world’s markets bow to the nation

pension_age_raised.decay: Citizens gain the gift of more work

cameras_banned.ascent: Face scanners are banned in public
cameras_banned.decay: The office trusts its citizens’ faces

drugs_crackdown.decay: The nation is cleaned, street by street

wage_raised.ascent: The minimum wage is raised by law
wage_raised.decay: The office raises every humble wage

broke_inquiry.decay: No inquiry is needed, the office finds

broke_balance.ascent: The promise to balance the books is broken
broke_balance.muddle: Balance the books? Lost the books
broke_balance.decay: The deficit is a sign of ambition

broke_homes.ascent: The promised homes are not built
broke_homes.decay: Families rest content in their queues

court_left.ascent: The court is left alone, as it was
court_left.decay: The court is permitted to continue

no_truth_law.ascent: No law will decide what is true
no_truth_law.muddle: Say what you like! Everyone does
no_truth_law.decay: The office trusts the people’s ears

debt_kept.muddle: Still owe? Still owe. Sorry, grads
debt_kept.decay: The young learn the joy of repayment

pension_age_kept.ascent: The pension age is kept where it is
pension_age_kept.muddle: Put your feet up! Same age as before
pension_age_kept.decay: The office keeps its word to the old

wage_left.ascent: Wages are left to employers to set
wage_left.muddle: Your pay? Ask the boss. Nicely

dirty_politics.ascent: The campaign wins, and the methods show

habit_clamp.ascent: The office gives the same answer again

habit_bend.ascent: The rules bend for the same families
habit_bend.muddle: Rules for thee, bends for friends!
habit_bend.decay: The office rewards its loyal friends

habit_skim.decay: The office’s fees are modest and regular
